test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
You have three tasks due:

A project worth 50% of your grade (due in 3 days )

A team meeting (in 1 hour)

An optional quiz (due tonight)

What should you do first?
solution:
According to the question:

First task should be → A team meeting (in 1 hour), because of the closest deadline. It is immediate and time-bound.

Thus, should attend the team meeting first.

Hence,** "Option 3"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

A project worth 50% of your grade (due in 3 days ) → Most Important among all three tasks but not the most urgent and have time to prepare even after the meeting.

An optional quiz (due tonight) → Least in priority and have time to prepare even after the meeting.
